onepiece:frost_turnip_stew: A Drum Island stew. Winter Islands can't freeze you for 20 minutes, plus Resistance.

onepiece:ghost_pumpkin_pie: Spooky and sweet. Night Vision for 15 minutes and Resistance for 10.

onepiece:ranch_trough: Fill with fodder. Animals within 8 blocks give milk, eggs, wool, truffles and manure, and breed on their own. Put a chest under or beside it.
onepiece:straw_hat_scarecrow: Marks a crew farm plot. A crewmate set to Work within 6 blocks of it farms, sows, feeds troughs and stores the harvest.
onepiece:sea_prism_vein: Pure sea prism deep under the islands (below y -32). Needs a Seastone pickaxe or better.
onepiece:abyss_stone: The black rock at the bottom of the deep mines. Only a Sea Prism pickaxe can cut it.
onepiece:abyss_stone_bricks: Carved Abyss Stone. Only a Sea Prism pickaxe can cut it.
onepiece:sun_coral_ore: Only found under Fishman Island. Glows.
onepiece:rock_candy_ore: Only found under Whole Cake and Cacao Island.
onepiece:giant_iron_ore: Only found under Elbaph and Little Garden.
onepiece:gloom_crystal_ore: Only found under Thriller Bark and Kuraigana.
onepiece:mining_drill: Fuel it, fit a bit, and it digs a 3x3 tunnel into an Ore Cart beside it. A crewmate set to Work next to it runs it.
onepiece:ore_cart: Put it beside a Mining Drill: everything the drill digs lands in here.
onepiece:sea_prism_shard: Four of these, two Seastone ingots and a Giant Iron ingot make a Sea Prism ingot (beat Magellan first).
onepiece:sea_prism_ingot: The best tool metal in the world. Makes Sea Prism tools and drill bits.
onepiece:desert_amber: Alabasta amber. Trade it for Berries, or keep it.
onepiece:sun_coral: Glowing coral from Fishman Island. Goes into the Sea Prism shovel.
onepiece:rock_candy: Eat it for two minutes of Haste II.
onepiece:giant_iron_ingot: The giants of Elbaph forge their weapons from it. Needed for Sea Prism.
onepiece:egghead_alloy: Vegapunk's future metal. Goes into the Sea Prism drill bit.
onepiece:gloom_crystal: Use it to see which ores hide in the rock within 12 blocks, and where.
onepiece:electro_crystal: Charged like a Mink. Great drill fuel (160 blocks), and part of the Sea Prism pickaxe.
onepiece:snake_jade: Green jade of the Kuja. Trade it for Berries, or use it in the Sea Prism axe.
onepiece:adam_drill_bit: Drill bit: 32 block tunnels, 600 blocks, iron-level rock.
onepiece:seastone_drill_bit: Drill bit: 64 block tunnels, 2400 blocks, cuts Sea Prism Veins.
onepiece:sea_prism_drill_bit: Drill bit: 128 block tunnels, 9000 blocks, cuts anything (even Abyss Stone).
onepiece:adam_pickaxe: Adam Wood: tough as the Thousand Sunny. Iron-level mining, lasts a long time.
onepiece:adam_axe: Adam Wood: tough as the Thousand Sunny. Iron-level mining, lasts a long time.
onepiece:adam_shovel: Adam Wood: tough as the Thousand Sunny. Iron-level mining, lasts a long time.
onepiece:seastone_pickaxe: Seastone: diamond-level, cuts Sea Prism Veins. Hits drain Devil Fruit users.
onepiece:seastone_axe: Seastone: diamond-level, cuts Sea Prism Veins. Hits drain Devil Fruit users.
onepiece:seastone_shovel: Seastone: diamond-level, cuts Sea Prism Veins. Hits drain Devil Fruit users.
onepiece:sea_prism_pickaxe: Sea Prism: the best there is, cuts Abyss Stone. Hits drain Devil Fruit users.
onepiece:sea_prism_axe: Sea Prism: the best there is, cuts Abyss Stone. Hits drain Devil Fruit users.
onepiece:sea_prism_shovel: Sea Prism: the best there is, cuts Abyss Stone. Hits drain Devil Fruit users.
onepiece:sea_king_fang: Rare Sea King drop. Forged into a blade at the Swordsmith's Forge (Tempering Anvil).
onepiece:ambergris: Rare Island Whale drop. Needed for Sanji's Kitchen and the Ambergris Roast at the Ship's Galley.
onepiece:dragon_heartstone: Rare Punk Hazard Dragon drop. Lights the Dragon Hearth at the Swordsmith's Forge.
onepiece:pacifista_core: Rare Pacifista drop. Powers Franky's Workshop at the Shipwright's Bench.
onepiece:tone_dial: Sneak + use to record a chat message (or a music disc in your other hand). Use to play it back.
onepiece:jet_dial: Blasts you far forward, then lets you float down. Much stronger than a Breath Dial.
onepiece:water_dial: Puts out fire on you and around you. Aim at a block to pour out water.
onepiece:milky_dial: Lays a road of solid cloud ahead of you, even over water. It melts after 30 seconds.
onepiece:reject_dial: Use to brace: hits in the next 3 s are stored. Use again to slam them back, double. It hurts you too.
onepiece:axe_dial: A blade of wind that cuts everything in a line ahead.
onepiece:eisen_dial: Puts up a wall of solid cloud in front of you. It melts after 30 seconds.
onepiece:sea_king_fang_blade: A sword forged from Sea King fangs. Sharper than diamond.
onepiece:takoyaki: Cooking Tier II. Haste and Water Breathing.
onepiece:sea_king_ramen: Cooking Tier II. Strength II and a little Regeneration.
onepiece:kibi_dango: Cooking Tier II. Luck and Speed.
onepiece:wedding_cake_slice: Cooking Tier III. Absorption III, Regeneration II and Strength.
onepiece:ambergris_roast: Cooking Tier III. Strength II, Resistance II and Fire Resistance for 6 minutes.
onepiece:diable_flambe: Cooking Tier III. Fire Resistance, Speed II and Strength II.
